validation_results.details: All 25 physical pages retain page-aware text and nonblank rendered pixels. Sequential reading plus eight byte-bounded JPEG reviews covers every page, all 27 numbered equations, 11 figure instances, ten tables, four algorithm-or-layout objects, numerical results, sensitivity analysis, conclusions, references, and the manager-facing article without returning an original-detail full-page raster.

The complete 25-page paper was read in order rather than keyword-skimmed: Summary and Contents; drought context and the negotiator's four tasks; assumptions, notation, data, and model overview; claimant minima and the first allocation program; repeated reservoir operation; lake geometry, rainfall, evaporation, inflow, release, mass balance, and hydropower relations; no-inflow duration; lower-stage supplementation; the upper-stage agricultural, industrial, and electricity objective; genetic and differential-evolution procedures; shortage-state search; population, demand-reduction, and operating-level scenarios; sensitivity analysis; strengths, weaknesses, conclusions, references, and the manager-facing article. Printed symbols, coefficients, units, cross-references, duplicated figure numbering, numerical conflicts, arbitrary thresholds, missing cells, seven-state scope expansion, Gulf and Mexico gaps, and claim boundaries were retained rather than silently repaired.

309 source-anchored language units cover all 13 normalized chapters and 27 source sections, beginning with the six-paragraph Summary and thirteen-paragraph Introduction chains. Nine repeated B-language patterns retain occurrences, rhetorical function, information order, slots, variants, boundary, disposition, and two unrelated original instantiations; their occurrence counts are 16, 31, 6, 108, 71, 25, 18, 15, and 19 in catalog order. The learned human-paper cadence repeatedly moves from task or condition to physical or economic reason to model and constraint to solver to number, figure, or table to a short interpretation and handoff. It preserves the source's ordinal 'Firstly' through 'Finally' ladder, immediate premise-and-justification assumptions, 'Considering', 'According to', 'At the same time', and 'In summary' transitions, figure-first interpretation, repeated noun labels, and manager-facing finding-to-recommendation prose. Language remains the largest evidence dimension by a wide margin.

309/309 language units passed the complete extracted-source anti-copy audit. Every unit has two unrelated instantiations; there are zero full-clause matches, zero unique eight-word matches, zero source-fact leaks, and the maximum shared content run is two words, well below the eight-word failure threshold.

Positive organization evidence retains 15 paper-card writing-logic artifacts, 13 normalized five-move chapter contracts spanning 27 source sections, a twelve-stage global chain, and 18 main argument chains. The reusable handoff is visible drought and consequences -> negotiator tasks -> assumptions, notation, data, and model overview -> claimant minima and a first allocation program -> repeated reservoir operation -> lake geometry, monthly balance, and hydropower -> no-inflow duration -> lower-stage supplementation -> upper-stage benefit optimization -> evolutionary solution procedures -> shortage-state and scenario tests -> sensitivity and bounded conclusions -> manager communication and references.

Twenty typed model units retain all 27 visually checked numbered equations, 20 explicit algorithms or procedures, 20 model-level validation records, and 30 typed dependency edges. The chain preserves claimant minimum-demand constraints, population-proportional Mexico minima, the first linear allocation program, repeated-operation updates, lake surface and volume relations, monthly precipitation-evaporation-inflow-release balance, hydropower conversion, no-inflow duration, lower-stage supplementation, upper-stage agricultural-industrial-electricity value, genetic and differential-evolution procedures, shortage search, scenarios, sensitivity analysis, and manager recommendations while recording unit conflicts, lake-specific fit gaps, inconsistent bounds and totals, arbitrary thresholds, solver-certificate gaps, seven-state scope expansion, and missing legal-physical Gulf closure.
